name: Chiang Yen
bio: Chiang Yen (AD 443–504) lived under the Southern dynasties. Giles prints one poem of his, on a battlefield and the forgotten names of the dead.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Forgotten
poems.author: Chiang Yen
poems.text:
To learn the art of fencing, forth
I wandered, with my master, north.
I saw an ancient battle-plain
Engirt by hills which still remain;
And while I gazed upon the scene,
A wide expanse of sky and green,
I thought how like a summer's day
Each warrior's name has passed away.
